filesystem._denyWrite_removed: Removed 2026-09-07 at the operator's instruction, completing the guardrail removal begun in the PreToolUse hook. These four globs were the second enforcement layer and still blocked writes the hook no longer refused: **/.claude/gates.json, **/.claude/hooks/**, **/bin/verify, **/.github/workflows/**. Cost: nothing in this repo's own configuration now prevents an agent from editing the gates, the hooks, bin/verify or the CI workflows. Branch protection and review are what remain. sandbox.enabled, failIfUnavailable and allowUnsandboxedCommands are untouched.
